app.name: CiftPay
app.tagline: Get paid on M-Pesa. Issue the KRA invoice before you put your phone down.

common.offline: You're offline. Showing what we saved last time.
common.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
common.noConnection: Can't reach CiftPay right now. Check your connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Enter the phone number registered with your business. We'll text you a 6-digit code.
login.phoneInvalid: That doesn't look like a Kenyan mobile number.
login.codeSentTo: Code sent to {msisdn}. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
login.wrongCode: That code didn't match. Check the SMS and try again.
login.footer: By signing in you accept that CiftPay never holds your money — it only reads M-Pesa confirmations and files invoices with KRA on your behalf.

today.title: Today
today.payments: {count, plural, =0 {No payments yet} one {# payment} other {# payments}}
today.emptyPayments: No M-Pesa payments yet today. The next one shows up here on its own.

payments.title: Payments
payments.empty: No M-Pesa payments here yet. The next one shows up on its own.
payments.convertTitle: Turn this payment into a KRA invoice
payments.convertLead: Pick what was sold. We'll file the invoice with KRA and text the buyer.
payments.buyerPinHint: Lets the buyer deduct this expense.
payments.converted: Invoice queued. KRA usually answers within a minute.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.empty: No invoices yet. Your first M-Pesa payment will create one.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.empty: Nothing needs you right now. Every payment has its invoice.
attention.unmatchedLead: We couldn't tell what {amount} from {msisdn} was for.
attention.unverifiedLead: Till {shortcode} isn't verified. We'll send KES 1 to your phone to confirm you control it.
attention.pendingLongLead: KRA is slow right now. We'll keep trying and text the buyer when it's through.

items.title: Items
items.empty: No items yet. Add what you sell so invoices carry the right KRA code.
items.name: Name
items.codeHint: Search by what you sell, e.g. 'bread' or 'airtime'.
items.priceHint: VAT-inclusive. Leave empty to type it at sale time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.receiptLead: Buyers get an SMS with a link to a verifiable KRA receipt.

sale.title: Record a sale
sale.lead: For cash or a payment we didn't see. We'll file it with KRA right away.
sale.queued: Invoice queued. KRA usually answers within a minute.
sale.offlineQueued: Saved. We'll file it with KRA as soon as you're back online.

accountant.title: Clients
accountant.lead: Every client's M-Pesa income, already reconciled and fiscalised.
accountant.empty: No client businesses yet. Ask a merchant to add you as their accountant.

admin.title: Ops
admin.lead: Submissions stuck with KRA, org search, feature flags.
admin.empty: Nothing stuck. The queue is clear.

receipt.title: KRA receipt {code}
receipt.verifiedLead: KRA has this invoice on record. The number and signature above match KRA's copy.
receipt.pendingLead: The seller has filed this with KRA. It'll show as verified once KRA answers.
receipt.cancelledLead: This invoice was reversed. The credit note above cancels it.
receipt.cta: Issue your own eTIMS receipts — CiftPay
receipt.notFoundLead: Check the link in your SMS. Codes are 6 characters, like 7KQ2M9.
